u.0.1.31.1.s: LYNX SHARE 0.1.31.1 fixes what you reported on 0.1.31: automation of FL projects on the controls, plugin windows that stopped opening, the Device view, Export with a folder in the file name, clips on instrument tracks, a crash in the hint bar and start-up memory.
u.0.1.31.1.f0: FL automation clips that drive several controls, or one through a formula, move every control they drive in the Mixer, the plugin windows and the Device view; a control moved by hand shows the value you hear (#253).
u.0.1.31.1.f1: Docked plugin and channel windows open where they were again instead of drifting out of the main window after a few clicks.
u.0.1.31.1.f2: Clip-launch layout: choosing a track in the Arrangement shows its devices, and the Device view's knobs follow automation.
u.0.1.31.1.f3: Export audio with a folder in the file name writes there without asking again (#215); Automatic colors and icons take more than one rule (#239); right-clicking the hint bar no longer crashes LYNX (#269).
u.0.1.31.1.f4: Track-only mode and the Simple layout: a double-click on an empty clip of an instrument track opens its notes.
u.0.1.31.1.f5: 0.1.31 used ~7 MB more memory and more CPU right after start-up.
u.0.1.31.1.k0: LYNX ASIO problems reported on 0.1.31 could not be reproduced yet; details help (Help › Report a problem...).
